displayName: Let Apps Activate With Voice Above Lock
description: This policy setting specifies whether Windows apps can be activated by voice while the system is locked.

options.displayName: User in control. Users can decide if Windows apps can be activated by voice while the screen is locked using Settings > Privacy options on the device.
options.description: User in control. Users can decide if Windows apps can be activated by voice while the screen is locked using Settings > Privacy options on the device.

options.displayName: Force allow. Windows apps can be activated by voice while the screen is locked, and users cannot change it.
options.description: Force allow. Windows apps can be activated by voice while the screen is locked, and users cannot change it.

options.displayName: Force deny. Windows apps cannot be activated by voice while the screen is locked, and users cannot change it.
options.description: Force deny. Windows apps cannot be activated by voice while the screen is locked, and users cannot change it.

keywords: Let Apps Activate With Voice Above Lock
